<!-- pr-reviewer: ced6931dad5c86b7974f8460112f07697b4be961 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @seelesturm - a tidy, well-pinned fix.

**What looks good**
- Additive `multi_pass_in` / `chamfer_in` / `taper_in`, with the old entry points kept as no-stock wrappers. This reuses the #278 `StockEnv` / `Exit::inside` rule, so there is no new geometry or schema.
- Safety: a radial exit goes at plunge feed only when stock continues past the cut end. Rapid radius clears the stock OD. Stock-empty roughing rungs are dropped but the leave floor and all finishing rides are kept. This raises no gouge or rapid-into-stock concern.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added. No build.rs, `.github/`, script or dependency changes. The layering is unchanged.
- Tests pin the defect through real setup, generation and posting. Provenance and gate-map headers are present, the decision file is in `docs/decisions/`, and the body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #323`.

**Local results (trial-merged with current origin/main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| motion `turning_contour_stock` | 4 passed |
| app `turning_contour_stock` | 3 passed |
| motion `turning_contour` / `turning_prof` / `turning_stock` | 13 / 8 / 5 passed |
| app `turning_contour` / `turning_axial_rapids` / `turning_stock_approach` / `turning` | 10 / 3 / 3 / 5 passed |
| app lib `turning` filter | 9 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `turning_rapids_tests.rs` has no trailing newline at EOF; this is cosmetic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
